ConstBooth vs GetAngie: The First-Ever Online Photobooth for LDRs

Looking for GetAngie or a free alternative? Discover the story behind the first-ever online photobooth for long-distance couples and friends, and how the two compare on watermarks, print quality, and cost.

Kishan Naik
September 23, 2026
7 min read

Before copycats and paid clones appeared, ConstBooth was built with a single mission: to let long-distance couples and best friends step into the same photo booth together in real time, directly in their browsers, 100% free.

If you found this page looking for GetAngie or an alternative to it, here is the honest story behind the first-ever online photobooth for long-distance couples and friends, and how the two platforms compare.

Long-distance relationships and friendships are hard enough without technology getting in the way. Whether your partner is living three time zones away, your best friend just moved across the country for college, or your favorite person is simply home for the weekend, shared rituals keep people close.

Taking photos together has always been one of those rituals. The excitement of cramming into a small photobooth curtain, choosing an aesthetic border, counting down 3... 2... 1..., and holding a real paper photo strip at the end is something special. ConstBooth was built to bring that exact feeling into your web browser, allowing two people anywhere on Earth to step into the same virtual frame.

Quick Comparison: ConstBooth vs GetAngie

Here is a direct side-by-side look at what you get with each platform:

Why Pay $10/Month for a Photo Strip?

One of the biggest frustrations visitors experience with GetAngie is hitting a paywall right when it matters most. You get ready, invite your partner, pose through four synchronized snapshots, laugh through the countdown, and reach the download screen, only to discover an ugly watermark stamped across your photos unless you pay $10 every month for an "Angie Pass".

At ConstBooth, our founding belief is that personal memories should never be held hostage behind a subscription. When you capture a moment with someone you care about, that keepsake belongs to you. Every single photo strip you make on ConstBooth is 100% unbranded, watermark-free, and high-definition from day one.

  • No watermarks: Your photo strips look authentic and clean, perfect for sharing on social media or printing.
  • No hidden fees: Every vintage filter, custom border, and layout format is completely unlocked for everyone.
  • No credit card required: You will never see a prompt asking for your payment details or pushing you to upgrade.

Print-Ready 300 DPI vs. Screen-Compressed Photos

Real photo booth strips are tangible. People love printing them out, sliding them behind clear phone cases, pinning them to bedroom corkboards, taping them to bathroom mirrors, or pasting them into scrapbooks. If you have ever tried printing an image that was compressed for quick phone viewing, you know the disappointment: fuzzy edges, pixelated faces, and dull colors.

ConstBooth designs every strip layout to exact physical printing standards. As detailed in our photo strip sizes and dimensions guide, standard photobooth strips measure 2×6 inches, requiring a true 300 DPI export (600×1800 pixels) to print razor-sharp on home photo printers, Canon Selphy machines, or print kiosks at CVS and Walgreens.

While Angie reserves HD downloads for paying subscribers, ConstBooth gives you ultra-crisp, print-ready files automatically on every download, solo or shared. Check out our step-by-step guide on how to print photo strips at home to learn how easy it is.

Two Different Philosophies: Dedicated Keepsake Studio vs. Mini-Game Hub

Beyond pricing, the two platforms were built with fundamentally different purposes in mind:

GetAngie: Couples Date Hub
Angie is designed as a broad date-night portal featuring relationship trivia, drawing boards, and conversation starters, with a photobooth as one of several bundled features.
ConstBooth: Pure Memory Studio
ConstBooth is dedicated to the craft of physical and digital keepsakes, offering authentic Korean 4-cut layouts, retro film filters, and a nostalgic creative Studio.

Because ConstBooth focuses entirely on photography and memory-making, we created the ConstBooth Studio: three unique ways to turn your photo strips into heartfelt keepsakes:

  • ConstBooth Letters: Write a digital love letter, choose your stationery, attach your favorite photo strips, add stamps, fold it into a custom envelope, and share it with someone far away.
  • ConstBooth Cassette: Pick a vintage cassette tape, write a track title, add your photo strip, and record a warm audio voice message that slides into an animated player.
  • ConstBooth Radio: A retro tabletop radio where visitors can broadcast and listen to anonymous, heartwarming voice notes from strangers across the world.

Which One Should You Choose?

Here is the honest recommendation depending on what you are looking for:

You might prefer GetAngie if: You want a collection of couples mini-games, truth-or-dare questions, and drawing games to kill time on a call, and you don't mind watermarks on your free photo strips.

You will love ConstBooth if: You want the first-ever online photobooth built for long-distance couples and friends. If you value clean, watermark-free photo strips, crystal-clear 300 DPI print quality, retro Korean 4-cut styling, and a dedicated memory-crafting studio, all 100% free with no monthly fees, ConstBooth is where you belong.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the difference between ConstBooth and GetAngie?

ConstBooth is the first-ever online photobooth for long-distance couples and friends, designed to create high-resolution, watermark-free photo strips 100% free with no subscriptions. GetAngie is a couples date-night platform that bundles a photobooth with quizzes and games, but charges a $10/month subscription (Angie Pass) to remove watermarks and download HD strips.

Is ConstBooth really 100% free with no watermarks?

Yes. Every photo strip and instant card created on ConstBooth can be downloaded in full 300 DPI high resolution with absolutely zero watermarks. You will never be asked for a credit card, monthly pass, or subscription.

Can two people in different locations take photos together on ConstBooth?

Yes! With ConstBooth Shared Booth, one person opens the booth and shares a private link with their partner or friend. Both cameras connect instantly with an automated, synchronized countdown shutter so you both snap at the exact same moment into a single shared strip.

Can I print my ConstBooth photo strips at home?

Yes. ConstBooth exports photo strips at standard physical print dimensions (2×6 inches and 3×4 instant cards at 300 DPI), making them crystal-clear for home photo printers, print kiosks at CVS or Walgreens, and scrapbooks.

Do I need to download an app or create an account?

No. ConstBooth runs directly in any modern browser on iPhone, Android, Mac, or Windows. You can take photos and download your strips immediately as a guest without downloading an app or creating an account.

What is ConstBooth Studio?

ConstBooth Studio is a collection of creative digital keepsakes. You can fold your photo strips into digital love letters with custom stamps (ConstBooth Letters), record personal voice messages onto animated retro cassette tapes (ConstBooth Cassette), or tune in to cozy voice notes from around the world on ConstBooth Radio.
